role: Federal highway and transportation funding source
stance_basis: described only as a funding source with no expressed position on the project
summary: The Federal Highway Administration is mentioned solely in its capacity as a federal funding source that allocates monies to highway and other transportation programs, with Federal Aid Urban (FAU) funds usable for either highway or transit capital projects at the discretion of county FAU committees. It also appears in financial summary figures as a capital funding contributor (FHWA) for the Regional Transit Development Program. No position for or against the project is expressed.
complaint_summary: The FHWA is described as a federal funding source that allocates monies to highway and other transportation programs, with FAU funds available for highway or transit capital projects at county FAU committee discretion.
